diagram.title: Align axes before reducing
diagram.prediction: Why is checking that the loss is scalar insufficient?
diagram.reading: Feature bias reuses a vector across observations; row offsets reuse each scalar across features. The final row creates all-pairs residuals. A mean would hide the unwanted \((n,n)\) intermediate. Each row describes a different shape contract.
